# Agent Seat Protocol v0.1.0

This is the first supported source release of the independent Apache-2.0 Agent
Seat product under ZaguanLabs ownership.

## Included components

- `agent-seat-proto` 0.1.1: strict, bounded wire revision 3
- `agent-seat-mcp` 0.1.1: authority-free MCP `2025-11-25` companion
- `agent-seat-x11` 0.1.4: standalone Linux X11 Tier 0 provider

The Tier 0 core supports bounded EWMH observation and events,
freshness-checked supported management, and policy-controlled shell-free XDG
desktop-entry launch beside Openbox 3.6.1. It uses explicit same-user grants,
a private pathname socket, and atomic per-screen provider ownership.

Capture, input, human-activity attribution, and accessibility are not included
or advertised. Their first-release safety decisions are documented rather than
silently weakened.

## Compatibility

`agent-seat-mcp` 0.1.1 and `agent-seat-x11` 0.1.4 are compatible over exact
wire revision 3. Nobox v0.1.3 uses its separately implemented revision 2 and is
intentionally incompatible in either direction; forced cross-version probes
fail closed during opening.

See `docs/compatibility.md`, `docs/c0-verification.md`, and
`docs/optional-profiles.md` in the source archive for the exact matrix,
evidence, and non-goals.

## Source assets

`agent-seat-proto-0.1.0.tar.gz` is the verified Git archive. Its adjacent
`.sha256` asset authenticates the archive bytes. Build with Rust 1.85 or newer
using the commands in `README.md`; binary distribution is intentionally out of
scope.
